note: D5 publishes bpmn_io.codec in 0.3.0 on owner GO; this receipt pins the implementing checkout, not the release.

oracleParity.f7: equal wherever both lanes encode (same suite)

xfail: test_warning_cap_pointer (strict): sealed warning-cap-01 expects the truncation to point at the first omitted warning (F1 plan step 3); the literal native 1000-warning cap delivers an element-less marker, so the path stays null

A1.obligation: Opaque unknown-namespace content round-trips without interpretation.
evidence: neutral-ext-01 (nested generics, foreign attrs, unregistered xmlns)
multipackage-01 (two vendor namespaces on one owner)

A2.obligation: Unregistered xmlns declarations are carried in JSON, never a side table.

G1.obligation: Lossless generic preservation: XML to native to JSON to native to XML keeps every retained QName, URI, value, body and child order.
evidence: project(hydrate(J)) == J on every sealed wire (test_f1_vectors)
hydrate(project(M)) fixed points incl. MIWG originals (test_miwg)
F7 byte parity with the Node oracle (test_oracle_f1)

G2.obligation: Receiver-side acceptance: unknown content never breaks typed processing, and every native loss or refusal surfaces as a typed diagnostic.
evidence: 1000-warning cap + truncation (warning-cap-01 sealed vector; truncation path strict-xfailed)
O1 string gates + O2 complete tuples (o1-*, o2-*)
MIWG round trips with typed diagnostics only (test_miwg)

divergences: F7 apostrophe escaping: Node writes ', the literal Python port writes a raw quote (strict xfail; literal ports stay untouched).
O1-dirty trees: Python refuses before encoding while the literal Node writer emits raw bytes (entity-nul-01, entity-surrogate-01).
ns0-anonymized generics (rebinding/default reset) project but refuse hydrate/F7 identically in both lanes.
Warning-cap truncation path: null in Python (native cap hides the first omitted warning) vs first-omitted pointer in JS (Node does not cap); sealed in warning-cap-01.
designDefaults: O1 forbidden controls -> C0 minus TAB/LF/CR plus DEL plus C1 (F1 plan step 5).
unknown-type native failures share invalid-xsi-type (native messages do not distinguish them).
Whitespace-only gaps stay silent (no information); comments/PIs/CDATA/truncation always diagnose.
Element-count limit-1/limit enforced at the pre-pass unit level (native construction at that scale is not covered end to end).
Report/2 import-stage entries stay outside this lot; the diagnostic tuples are the handoff payload.
